Prompt 2 builds the complete Blueprint intelligence infrastructure. This includes the Blueprint Agent (read-only mode), the Governance Queue for blueprint change proposals, world state version enforcement across all blueprint operations, and the Bhudhi blueprint interpretation capability that converts raw blueprint data into plain-language strategic briefings for users.
THREE LAWS — RESTATE FOR THIS PROMPT

Blueprint structure is ENFORCED by the Control Engine and Blueprint Engine. The Blueprint Agent reads, analyzes, and proposes. It never writes to blueprint tables directly. All proposals enter the GovernanceQueue and require explicit approval.

No Bhudhi call ever creates, modifies, or deletes Plans, Phases, Projects, Actions, or Orders directly. Blueprint mutation is the exclusive domain of the BlueprintEngine acting on approved GovernanceQueue items.
World state version is enforced on all Blueprint Agent outputs. If the world state version in a Bhudhi response does not match the current version in the database, the output is rejected and logged.

This is the complete sequence when a user's validated goal is ready to become a blueprint. Every step must be implemented in this exact order.
ConditionEngine has run. User has a SignalRecord. ValidationVerdict = 'Proceed' OR 'Adjust'. Blueprint generation is unlocked.
Before generation: check ContradictionRecord table. If any HARD contradictions exist with status PENDING, block blueprint generation. User must resolve first.
TriggerRouter fires DOMAIN_RESOLUTION trigger. Strategy Agent resolves primary + secondary domains. Domain confidence score calculated. Framework stack assigned. Stored to Blueprint record.
TriggerRouter fires BLUEPRINT_GENERATION trigger. Blueprint Agent builds the full Plans → Targets → Phases → Projects → Actions structure. OutputValidator checks worldStateVersion and schema.
BlueprintEngine writes the validated structure to database in dependency order: Blueprint → Plans → Phases → Projects → Actions. worldStateVersion set to 1. No Orders created yet.
Blueprint Agent runs first health check immediately after creation. Identifies any structural issues before the user sees the blueprint. Proposals added to GovernanceQueue if needed.
blueprint.interpret.v1 runs. Plain-language briefing generated. Cached in BlueprintInterpretation table. User sees this on their dashboard.
Blueprint.status updated from Draft → Active. First phase set to Active. First project set to Active. Execution loop ready to generate first Order.
ControlEngine reads current condition. Task Generation Agent generates first Order. Order written to database. User sees their first task.
